item.title: Somebody has fly tipped outside our property and they are adding more items each day, 31st July
item.description:
Ref: SSR 126 3769 - This is an ongoing problem. The same thing happened about a year ago a small item dumped outside this encouraged fly-tipping, including dog waste bags. I am extremely frustrated that this latest pile of rubbish has now been here for over two and a half weeks. I first reported it last Monday and was assured it would be collected within 48 hours, but nobody came. I called again this Monday and have continued to chase every day since, yet it still has not been removed. My neighbours are also unhappy and have asked me to keep pursuing this, as the rubbish is bringing the area down and creating an unpleasant environment for everyone. Whoever dumped this waste should be held accountable. If I discover who is responsible, I will report them to the police.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): West Park, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Lowfield road/Neverwood street & Sheriff road., 31st July
item.description:
The bottom of sheriff Road beginning of Netherwood Street top of Lightfield Road there needs to be a no entry sign and the road needs to be a one-way street as it is extremely dangerous with motorbikes driving on the pavement, cars blocking the road and racial abuse, people putting their hands on their horn disturbing everyone on this street. All traffic from Kilburn Harbor Road comes along Kingsgate Road onto Nebo Street for them to go along sheriff Road or to Netherwood Street. Life needs to be a one-way street and all traffic coming from Netherwood Street needs to be diverted to Kylemore road and then down the one way road Hamstal road. We have children on this road and with bike on pavement it’s extremely dangerous. I have numerous video footage to show all of the numbers of times a day this happens. Please I’m begging you to get someone out to fix this issue as soon as possible. If you would like video evidence please feel free to email me on; Jadethain@outlook.com Many thanks, A concerned tenant, Jade Thain.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Lowfield Road, Kilburn, Greater London
